summary: The logistic regression model is well-calibrated based on Expected Calibration Error of 0.0128 (±0.0020). The model's predicted probabilities align reasonably well with observed frequencies across probability ranges.
methodological_choices: Model: Logistic Regression (standard for calibration studies). Preprocessing: Categorical encoding with LabelEncoder, numerical standardization with StandardScaler. Data split: 50-50 train-test split with stratification on target. Calibration metrics: ECE with 10 bins, Brier score, Log Loss. Threshold for well-calibrated: ECE < 0.10 (standard benchmark).
verification_method: 5 repeated 50-50 train-test splits with different random seeds (0-4). ECE, Brier score, and Log Loss computed on test set for each run.
verification_result: Finding CONFIRMED: All 5 runs showed ECE < 0.10 (mean=0.0128, range=[0.0104, 0.0153]). Model calibration is stable across different random seeds.
